NONE: › a secret purpose or reason for doing something
不可告人的動機／原因／目的（等等）

example: He claims he just wants to help Lisa but I suspect he has an ulterior motive.
他聲稱只是想幫助莉薩，但我懷疑他有不可告人的動機。

NONE: B2 most extreme or important because either the original or final, or the best or worst
極端的；最重要的；最初（或終）的；最好（差）的
› the best or most extreme example of something
…中最好的例子；…的極致；…中的極品

example: Of course the ultimate responsibility for the present conflict without doubt lies with the aggressor.
當然，挑起事端的一方毫無疑問應對目前的衝突承擔首要責任。
My manager will make the ultimate decision about who to employ.
我的經理會最終決定雇傭誰。
Infidelity is the ultimate betrayal.
通姦是最可恥的背叛。
the ultimate luxury cruiser
頂級豪華遊艇
The hotel is described as "the ultimate in luxury".
該旅館被描述爲「豪華的極致」。
I mean, tackling six men single-handedly - that really is the ultimate in stupidity!
我的意思是，獨自對付六個人——真是愚蠢至極！

NONE: C1 finally, after a series of things have happened
最終，最後
C2 used to emphasize the most important fact in a situation
終歸，終究

example: Everything will ultimately depend on what is said at the meeting with the directors next week.
一切將最終取決於下週開會和董事們商議的結果。
Ultimately, of course, he'd like to have his own business but that won't be for some time.
當然，他最終想擁有自己的企業，但那不會很快實現的。
Ultimately, he'll have to decide.
他終究要作出決定。

NONE: › a threat in which a person or group of people are warned that if they do not do a particular thing, something unpleasant will happen to them. It is usually the last and most extreme in a series of actions taken to bring about a particular result
最後通牒

example: He gave her an ultimatum - she could either stop seeing Peter and come back to him or it was divorce.
他向她下了最後通牒——她要麽不再見彼得，回到他身邊，要麽離婚。
On Wednesday night the UN issued its toughest ultimatum to date, demanding that all troops withdraw from the city.
星期三晚上，聯合國發出了迄今爲止最強硬的最後通牒，要求所有部隊從該城撤出。

NONE: › extreme or extremely
極；超

example: ultra-expensive
極昂貴的
ultra-modern architecture
超現代建築
ultra-sensitive
極敏感的
an ultra-short haircut
超短髮型

NONE: › an extremely light and small aircraft with a very small engine, designed to carry only one or two people
微型飛機
› a bright blue colour
群青色，佛青色
› Ultrasonic sound is too high for people to hear.
（聲音）超聲的
› a method of producing images that uses sound waves to view structures inside the body
超聲波檢查法，超聲波掃描術

example: The diagnosis was based on ultrasonography.
這一診斷是基於超聲波檢查法的結果。
renal ultrasonography
腎超聲檢查法

U: › [ U ] special sound waves used in such processes as examining organs inside the body and directing the route of submarines
超聲波（用於人體器官檢查、潛艇導航等）

example: They'll use ultrasound to monitor her ovaries.
他們將利用超聲波監測她的卵巢。

NONE: › Ultraviolet light has a wavelength that is after the violet (= light purple) end of the range of colours that can be seen by humans. Light of this type causes the skin to become darker in the sun.
紫外線的
